feed.title: Oracle vs. Alphabet: Which AI Cloud Stock Is the Better Buy?
feed.summary: This article compares Oracle (ORCL) and Alphabet (GOOGL) as AI cloud stocks, highlighting their differing financial models and investment risks. Oracle offers faster cloud growth at a lower earnings multiple but carries greater balance-sheet and execution risk, while Alphabet, despite costing more, has a broader and more profitable business funding its AI investments. The author suggests that for investors willing to accept financing risk, Oracle has more upside, but Alphabet is the stronger risk-adjusted choice.

feed.title: US jury says Apple owes record $5.7 billion in haptic technology patent case
feed.summary: A US jury has ordered Apple to pay San Diego-based Taction over $5.7 billion for infringing two of its patents related to haptic feedback technology used in iPhones and Apple Watches. Apple disputes the verdict, stating its Taptic Engine is fundamentally different from Taction's technology, and plans to appeal what is reportedly the largest such verdict to date. Taction, which applies its technology in headphones and gaming headsets, initiated the lawsuit in 2021, a case revived by a federal appeals court after an initial ruling favored Apple.

feed.title: Oracle vs. Alphabet: Which AI Cloud Stock Is the Better Buy?

The author concludes that while Oracle offers higher rerating upside for those willing to accept financing risk, Alphabet is the stronger risk-adjusted choice due to its more profitable business segments funding its AI growth.

This leadership change occurs as Coca-Cola HBC AG, the company's bottling partner, is nearing completion of a $2.55 billion acquisition of a 75% controlling interest in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa, with regulatory approvals progressing across various African jurisdictions. The transitions happen amidst shifting consumer behavior and economic pressures, though both Monster Beverage and Coca-Cola HBC have reported strong sales.

feed.title: Best Buy Is Turning Amazon Fire TV Into a New Advertising Opportunity

This initiative, set to launch in February 2027, will leverage Best Buy's customer data for programmatic advertising on connected televisions, turning hardware sales into recurring revenue. Despite some analyst skepticism and insider selling, the company's core retail business is stabilizing, and its advertising revenue, projected to approach $1 billion annually, is expected to significantly boost profitability and expand margins.

feed.title: At least 3 Starbucks on Long Island among 250 to be closed in latest round of shutdowns
feed.summary: Starbucks is closing approximately 250 North American stores, including at least three on Long Island, as part of a turnaround strategy. These closures represent about 1% of the company's North American shops and are primarily underperforming locations. The company aims to reestablish its position as a community coffeehouse by enhancing in-store experiences and remodeling existing stores, while employees from closed stores will have transfer or severance options.

feed.title: Acadia Pharmaceuticals Announces Phase 3 Enabling Topline Results from Phase 2 RADIANT Study of Remlifanserin for the Treatment of Alzheimer’s Disease Psychosis (ADP)
feed.summary: Acadia Pharmaceuticals announced positive Phase 2 results for remlifanserin in Alzheimer's Disease Psychosis (ADP), showing a significant reduction in hallucinations and delusions with the 60 mg dose, and a favorable safety profile. The company plans to continue its Phase 3 program, removing the 30 mg dose arm, and will present detailed findings at the CTAD conference. Remlifanserin is a novel 5HT2A receptor inverse agonist with no FDA-approved treatment currently available for ADP, addressing a high unmet medical need.

feed.title: Larry Ellison adds $9.2 billion in Oracle shares as loan collateral
feed.summary: Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison has pledged an additional 67 million Oracle shares, valued at approximately $9.2 billion, as collateral for personal loans, increasing his pledged stock by 19% since 2025. This move aligns with his financing efforts for his son David Ellison’s Paramount Skydance acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. feed.title: How Dental Financing Integration Will Impact Synchrony Financial (SYF) Investors
feed.summary: Synchrony Financial (SYF) is partnering with Intelibly Inc. to embed its CareCredit health and wellness credit card into Intelibly’s dental appointment platform, providing patients with financing options earlier in their care journey. This integration aligns with Synchrony's broader strategy of embedded finance, as seen with Amazon, Walmart, and PayPal, and is viewed as another test of this approach. While it is not expected to immediately transform the short-term earnings outlook, it could shift more dental spending towards Synchrony Financial's health and wellness vertical.
